name: Sony Headphones
author: Gabriel Aramburu
description: Control Sony WH-1000X headphones from the bar: noise cancelling, ambient sound, equalizer, DSEE Extreme, Bluetooth connection quality, listening mode, multipoint, Speak-to-Chat, voice guidance, battery and more. Speaks both the v1 (WH-1000XM2/XM3/XM4) and v2 (WH-1000XM5/XM6, WF-1000XM5, LinkBuds, CH720N) protocols.

barWidget.description: Noise cancelling, ambient sound, equalizer, DSEE Extreme, connection quality, listening mode, multipoint, Speak-to-Chat, voice guidance, pause-when-taken-off, auto power off and battery for Sony WH-1000X headphones, with a control-session toggle for sharing the headset with a phone.

schema.label: Battery in the bar
schema.description: Show the battery percentage next to the headphones icon.

schema.label: Bluetooth address
schema.description: Optional. Pin a specific MAC address when more than one pair of Sony headphones is connected.

schema.label: Logging
schema.description: How much the helper writes to its log file (errors only, everything, or nothing). The link at the bottom of the panel cycles the running daemon; this is the level a fresh daemon starts with.

schema.label: Control session
schema.description: A Sony headset allows one control session at a time. Hold keeps it, so the widget always has live settings. On-demand releases it after the idle delay, letting a phone take over; any command reclaims it.

schema.label: Release the session after (seconds)
schema.description: Only used when the control session is set to on-demand. Quiet seconds before the daemon hands the session back; any command restarts the count.
